comment_regular: Verified per-reference seed writer. For a TREE form, maps the requested uint32 seed through TESObjectTREE_GetIndexForSeed and stores the byte in ExtraData_Seed. If the tree seed array is empty or the seed is absent, the index is 0xFF; ExtraDataList_SetOrRemoveTreeSeed treats 0xFF as remove, so no concrete per-reference seed is retained. Whether another runtime path populates Oblivion's array remains Unknown.
